summary: Add Python type hints to the helper functions in src/peft/tuners/lora/config.py.
difficulty_reason: Only one file changes and no behaviour changes.
you_will_learn: How Python type hints work and how PEFT configures LoRA.
first_steps: Fork the repo and set up a development install.
Open src/peft/tuners/lora/config.py and add type hints to each helper.
Run the existing tests to check nothing broke.
